ai_summary: Allcargo Logistics Limited issued this clarification regarding the August 5, 2026 resignation of Board member Mr. Shashi Kiran Shetty, which was attributed to "other commitments." The company admits to inadvertently omitting the actual resignation letter from the initial regulatory disclosure. While this document corrects a minor compliance oversight, it highlights a procedural lapse in their reporting practices, though the company asserts no intent to withhold information.
